summary.business_type: Content / Fan Wiki & Strategy Guide (single-character niche site)
top_findings: CRITICAL: Fabricated Game+AggregateRating JSON-LD (9.4/10, 78 votes) violates Google review guidelines and risks a manual action
HIGH: Zero outbound citations/links — 'Data Sources' claims are unverifiable, hurting E-E-A-T vs Fandom/Game8/HoYoverse
HIGH: 2 of 3 planned mechanism SVG visualizations missing (state machine, combo timeline) — core information-gain weapon is only 1/3 built
HIGH: Hero LCP image not optimized (no fetchpriority, no preload, 113 KB)
HIGH: 404 page emits all rich structured data (VideoGame/HowTo/Game/etc.)
MEDIUM: Canonical (no-slash) vs sitemap (slash) homepage mismatch
MEDIUM: IndexNow key file exists but submission is not wired
quick_wins: Delete the Game+AggregateRating JSON-LD block (10-min fix, removes penalty risk)
Add fetchpriority='high' + preload to hero image and preload fonts
Add <link rel='indexnow'> + IndexNow submission at deploy
Add 3-5 outbound citation links to Data Sources section

categories.name: Technical SEO
what_works: robots.txt correct and references sitemap
XML sitemap-index + sitemap-0 well-formed
404 page has noindex, follow and clear H1
Canonical tag present on homepage
Zero third-party scripts (self-hosted assets only)

findings.title: Canonical vs sitemap homepage URL mismatch
findings.description: Canonical is https://www.lohen-genshin.com (no slash) but sitemap lists https://www.lohen-genshin.com/ (with slash, trailingSlash:'always'). Two URL forms for the homepage create indexation ambiguity.
findings.recommendation: Pick one form (no-slash per framework spec), keep sitemap and canonical identical, and add a 301 between the two forms.

findings.title: 404 page emits full rich structured data
findings.description: 404.html includes WebPage, VideoGame, Organization, BreadcrumbList, HowTo, and Game JSON-LD. Error pages should carry no structured data.
findings.recommendation: Strip all JSON-LD from the 404 template; keep only noindex meta and the link back to /.

findings.title: IndexNow key file exists but not wired
findings.description: 4e1f2c3d4a5b6789f0a1.txt exists at root but there is no <link rel='indexnow'> and no submission pipeline to api.indexnow.org. The file alone does nothing.
findings.recommendation: Wire IndexNow submission (Cloudflare Pages IndexNow integration or a worker) before/at launch.

findings.title: No security headers verifiable pre-deploy
findings.description: No live origin to inspect. CSP, HSTS, X-Content-Type-Options, Referrer-Policy cannot be confirmed.
findings.recommendation: Add security headers via Cloudflare Pages _headers at deployment; enable HSTS.

categories.name: Content Quality
what_works: 17,347 words of deep, non-padded content (target 5-7k)
All 6 search intents covered on one page in user-journey order
16 H2 / 56 H3 hierarchy; 15 data tables; 60 FAQ questions
60 details blocks all contain real content in initial HTML (SEO-safe)
Strong E-E-A-T block: AR 60, 1,800+ hrs, tested C0/C1, dated, disclaimer

findings.title: No outbound citations — Data Sources unverifiable
findings.description: The About block claims 'Data Sources: HoYoLAB, 6.6 beta' but the page has zero external links. No verifiable provenance for stats; weak vs established wikis.
findings.recommendation: Add real outbound links to HoYoLAB official pages, miHoYo 6.6 notices, and community test threads in the Data Sources section.

findings.title: Only 1 of 3 planned mechanism visualizations implemented
findings.description: The dual-resource flow SVG exists, but the Masterstroke state machine and Hexerei combo timeline SVGs are missing — the core information-gain differentiator is only 1/3 built (llms.txt overclaims them).
findings.recommendation: Build the 2 missing SVG visualizations (state machine, combo timeline with per-hit damage distribution).

findings.title: Duplicate FAQ question
findings.description: 'What is Lohen's role in the Knights of Favonius?' appears twice with near-identical answers (FAQ #17 and #38).
findings.recommendation: Remove or rewrite the duplicate.

findings.title: Anonymous author identity
findings.description: Author is an unnamed 'active player'; schema author is 'Editorial Team' (Organization). Inconsistent identity, but no /about/ page is planned (single-page site by design).
findings.recommendation: Give the author a stable pseudonym inline (Author component) and align schema author with the visible author. Keep the E-E-A-T block on the homepage.

categories.name: On-Page SEO
what_works: Title 63 chars, keyword-led: 'Lohen Genshin Impact Guide: Best Build, Mechanics & Teams (6.6)'
Meta description present and compelling (covers pull/build/mechanics/teams)
Exactly one H1; 16 H2 with strong keyword coverage
Full OG + Twitter card set with image
robots meta index, follow; descriptive alt text on hero
Internal anchor TOC (UX + internal-linking)

findings.title: LCP hero image missing fetchpriority/preload
findings.description: Hero img has no fetchpriority='high', no preload, no decoding='async'; 113 KB in the LCP slot.
findings.recommendation: Add fetchpriority='high', <link rel='preload' as='image'>, and decoding='async' to hero.

findings.title: Single-page architecture (by design)
findings.description: Single-page strategy confirmed: no subpages. All long-tail coverage handled by 59 FAQ answers and anchor sections on the one page.
findings.recommendation: Keep single-page; use community distribution to earn backlinks/brand searches instead of internal link equity.

categories.name: Schema / Structured Data
what_works: 7 schema types present (WebPage, VideoGame, Organization, BreadcrumbList, HowTo, Game, FAQPage)
WebPage has datePublished/dateModified/inLanguage/isPartOf/about
HowTo is valid with 5 steps and totalTime
FAQPage valid with 60 conclusion-first Q&A

findings.title: Fabricated Game + AggregateRating structured data
findings.description: Game entity with aggregateRating 9.4/10 and ratingCount 78, plus a review authored by the site's own editorial team. No user voting system exists on the page. This violates Google's review-snippet guidelines (self-serving/fake reviews) and risks a manual action.
findings.recommendation: Delete the Game+AggregateRating JSON-LD block immediately. If a rating is wanted, implement a real user voting widget and mark up only live aggregate data.

findings.title: 404 page schema pollution
findings.description: 404.html emits VideoGame/Organization/BreadcrumbList/HowTo/Game JSON-LD. Error pages must not carry rich entities.
findings.recommendation: Strip all JSON-LD from the 404 template.

findings.title: Duplicate FAQ question in FAQPage
findings.description: Same Knights of Favonius question twice in mainEntity.
findings.recommendation: Deduplicate the FAQ array.

findings.title: Author identity inconsistent
findings.description: Schema author Organization 'Editorial Team' vs visible text 'active player'.
findings.recommendation: Align to a single named author entity.

categories.name: Performance (CWV)
what_works: Zero third-party scripts/fonts/ads — excellent for INP and privacy
Only ~9 KB inline JS; 28 KB single CSS
Hero has width/height (CLS-safe)
WebP hero image; no external requests

findings.title: LCP not optimized (hero image)
findings.description: No fetchpriority='high', no preload, no decoding='async'; 113 KB WebP in the LCP slot. Lab estimate 1.5-2.5s mobile.
findings.recommendation: Add fetchpriority='high' + preload + decoding='async'; compress hero toward ~70 KB.

findings.title: Fonts not preloaded
findings.description: 47 KB variable Outfit font has no preload hints; text may swap late.
findings.recommendation: Preload the two woff2 files; confirm font-display: swap.

findings.title: Single 280 KB HTML document
findings.description: 17k words + 7 JSON-LD + 4 tool scripts inlined into one file; heavy parse on low-end mobile.
findings.recommendation: Acceptable for now; defer tool scripts if mobile LCP suffers after launch.

findings.title: No brand mention signals yet

findings.recommendation: Seed brand searches and mentions via community distribution post-launch.

Strip all JSON-LD from the 404 template
Align canonical + sitemap homepage URL (single form) and add 301 between forms

phases.name: Phase 2: High-Impact Improvements
items: Add fetchpriority='high' + preload + decoding='async' to hero image; compress to ~70 KB
Preload the 2 Outfit font files; confirm font-display: swap

items: Run PageSpeed Insights + CrUX after deploy to replace lab estimates with field data
Track GSC impressions/clicks/CTR for 'lohen genshin' and long-tail variants

Update content with 6.6 live-test data on launch day to catch the freshness window
Monthly freshness updates + version-following (per 建站框架 6.5.7)
